compiled_state.title: As a migrated host project, legacy key reads are rejected after migration sentinel exists
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update `read-config.sh` to enforce a hard lockout on legacy key reads after the migration sentinel `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` is committed to the host repository. After migration, any call to `read-config.sh merge.strategy` (or the other three legacy keys) exits non-zero with a recovery message.

**Why**: The sentinel lockout converts the deprecation warning (warn-and-continue) into a hard error (fail-fast), completing the migration guarantee. It also makes the migrator reminder actionable: once the sentinel is committed, the host project is fully on `dso.workflow` and legacy key references in scripts that survived S6 cleanup will be caught immediately.

**Scope**:
- IN: Sentinel detection logic in `read-config.sh`; non-zero exit with recovery command for legacy keys post-sentinel; `dso.workflow` reads unaffected by sentinel; migrator reminder for gitignore coverage of `.claude/`; shell tests for sentinel-active and sentinel-absent paths
- OUT: The sentinel is created by S2 (migrator); this story only adds the lockout logic to the reader

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, after `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` sentinel exists (committed to the host repository), `read-config.sh <any-legacy-key>` exits non-zero with a stderr message referencing the recovery command (`git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf`)
  ← Satisfies: SC5 (post-sentinel lockout)
- When this story is complete, `read-config.sh dso.workflow` continues to function normally after the sentinel exists (lockout applies only to legacy keys)
  ← Satisfies: SC5 (dso.workflow reads unaffected)
- When this story is complete, the migrator emits a reminder to `git add` the sentinel if it detects `.gitignore` covers `.claude/`
  ← Satisfies: SC5 (sentinel commit reminder)
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The lockout must not fire during the migration commit itself — the sentinel file existence is the trigger. Scripts that read legacy keys before migration completes (during the S3→S6 window) must not be disrupted mid-migration.
- [Reliability] S3 lockout lands before S6 reference cleanup completes. The lockout logic must keep the shim warn-only (not hard-error) until the sentinel is explicitly committed. Implementation must choose: (a) sentinel-lockout is opt-in, activated by a second flag written only after S6 cleanup ships, or (b) sentinel must NOT be committed until S6 is merged. Either path must be explicitly documented in the migrator header comment and story implementation notes.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
